slides.texte_overlay:
5 habits that make you
feel in control again
(to feel like you again)

1. Clear one small mess a day
The sink, the desk, the inbox.
Order outside brings
order inside.

2. Cook your own dinner
Taking care of yourself
with your own hands
feels like control.

3. Walk without your phone
Twenty minutes. No input.
Your head finally
gets a word in.

4. Move your body daily
A run, a push-up set, a walk.
Proof you can still
make yourself do things.

5. Learn one new thing
A short lesson every day.
Growth is the fastest way
to feel like you again.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. Learn one new thing
I do 5 minutes a day
on the Sophia app.
Growth feels like me again.
